description: Moves one of your recipes, materials, notebook entries or firing logs to the Trash, as removing it on the website does. It can be put back from the Trash on the website for 30 days; nothing is deleted for good. A token moves at most 100 an hour, and none while the Trash is full. Remove only what the person asked to remove. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

id.description: Its id, from list_recipes, list_my_materials, list_notes or list_firings.

kind.description: What it is: a note is a notebook entry.

name: move_to_trash
title: Move one of my records to the Trash
